title: Audits and governance of student care centre operators after Little Professors closure
asked: Mr Shawn Loh asked whether the Government audits the financial viability and operational sustainability of Student Care Centre operators, how such audits are conducted, and whether it will improve governance processes to avoid future abrupt closures and disruptions.
response: Dr Janil Puthucheary said MOE was first alerted to issues at LPLC centres in February this year. Schools stepped in to provide interim after-school care, with relief manpower and support from parent groups, while MOE sources new SCC and KCare operators. Former LPLC staff are being supported with short-term financial relief, job referrals and career guidance, and can be employed in their original centres. On GIRO deductions, MOE filed a police report and advised parents to cancel GIRO and consider the Small Claims Tribunal; selection and monitoring of operators includes financial standing and yearly audited financial statements, and processes are being reviewed.

key_points.point: MOE was first alerted to issues at LPLC centres in February this year.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: the Ministry of Education (MOE) was first alerted to the issues at LPLC centres in February this year.

key_points.point: Schools stepped in to provide interim after-school support.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: Our schools have stepped in to provide interim after-school support.

key_points.point: MOE has started sourcing new SCC and KCare operators for affected schools.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: MOE has started sourcing for new SCC and KCare operators to provide after-school care for the students in the affected schools.

key_points.point: MOE is working with NTUC and the Education Services Union to support affected workers with short-term financial relief, job referrals and career guidance.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: We are working with the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) and the Education Services Union, who are supporting affected workers with short-term financial relief, job referrals and career guidance

key_points.point: MOE filed a police report on unauthorised GIRO deductions.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: MOE has filed a police report when these were reported to schools in February.

key_points.point: MOE advised affected parents to cancel their GIRO arrangements immediately and to consider filing a claim with the Small Claims Tribunal.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: We had at that point also advised affected parents to cancel their GIRO arrangements immediately and to consider filing a claim with the Small Claims Tribunal.

key_points.point: Operators must demonstrate adequate financial standing before being considered.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: operators have to demonstrate adequate financial standing before they are considered.

key_points.point: Since January 2025, all awarded contracts require yearly submission of audited financial statements.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: Since January 2025, all the contracts that have been awarded require then a yearly submission of audited financial statements.

key_points.point: MOE and schools maintain oversight over operators and monitor their performance in providing SCC and KCare services.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: MOE and schools maintain oversight over operators and monitor their performance in terms of how well they are providing the SCC and KCare services.

key_points.point: MOE is further reviewing its processes for selecting and monitoring SCC and KCare operators.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: We are further reviewing our processes for selecting and monitoring SCC and KCare operators.

left_open: Specific methodology of financial viability and operational sustainability audits beyond yearly audited financial statements
Timeline for the review of governance processes for SCCs
How operational sustainability is assessed separately from financial standing
supplementary: Supplementary questions focused on preventing future closures, early warning, parent fee protection, claim coordination and teacher workload.
